bio.text: Connie Chan represents District 1 on the San Francisco Board of Supervisors, a seat she has held since 2021, and is a Democratic candidate for California's 11th Congressional District in 2026.
According to her campaign website, she was born in Hong Kong, moved to San Francisco at age 13, and has chaired the Board of Supervisors Budget Committee since February 2023.
She graduated from Galileo High School and holds a bachelor's degree from the University of California, Davis.
